content: {"episode_id":"ep-05058","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229, Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring, which the payer states was denied because required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered. The clinical indication note documents that the patient presents with recurrent episodes of unexplained syncope and near-syncope (R55), raising concern for intermittent arrhythmia. Given the personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction (Z86.73), prolonged mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptoms with potential cardiac rhythm disturbances. We submit this formal appeal with the supporting clinical documentation and request reconsideration of the denied service."}
